_ssot: Rulings only -- no machine paths and no scan output. Paths live in the gitignored sites.local.json so any clone works in any directory; frozen hashes are never stored because a hash that disagrees with reality is worse than no record at all.
_rule: A skill is either shared infrastructure (exactly one copy, here, reached from every project through the user-level surfaces) or repo-owned (differentiated on purpose, living in that repo's big loop). Nothing is both. A repo holding its own copy of a shared name shadows the shared one silently -- that is what `check` exists to catch. A third state exists as of 2026-08-07: a name can be deliberately repo-owned in several repos at once. That is not shadowing -- nothing shared is being hidden -- so `check` must not report it as drift.
